license_note: Commercial release, not CC. Stems were released for the 2012 'Stems Project' remix contest and are already public (archive.org item 'bon-iver-bon-iver-full-album-stems'); the mixdown used here is a peak-normalized SUM of those official stems (same methodology MUSDB18 uses), not an independently sourced master - see README. Track filenames are deliberately obfuscated place names; the vocals/drums/bass/other split was built automatically (see reference_mapping.json's _method field and CONTRIBUTING.md), not by listening to each track.
genre_notes: indie-folk/orchestral, dense wall-of-sound production, falsetto lead with doubled vocal layers across only 2 of 10 tracks (sparser vocal-channel count than the other songs in this catalog, despite the album's reputation for heavy vocal layering) - a useful counterexample to 'more vocal harmony = more vocal tracks'
